name: partner-store-onboarding-publication
objective: Close field-owned partner draft/evidence/first-store onboarding through operator review and required publication/readback.
truthOwner: DSH owns partner/store/onboarding operational truth; WLT owns raw payout destination truth; field captures evidence, operator reviews, partner/client read committed outcomes.
journeys: field partner draft to governed store publication

tasks.objective: Close durable assignment-scoped field partner/first-store draft, evidence, documents, location, agreement and submission.
tasks.currentProblem: Screens and controllers exist, but same-SHA proof of resume/conflict/scope/durability and complete backend/data/audit convergence is incomplete.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace and correct the canonical draft lifecycle, version/idempotency identity, media/document ownership and submission prerequisites.
tasks.targetState: The field employee can create/resume/save and submit only authorized assigned drafts with durable evidence and precise conflict/recovery states.
tasks.action: Fix shared/controller/contract/backend/database owners first, retain working UI, then add negative scope/retry/restart tests.
mustNotChange: Field cannot approve its own evidence.
Field cannot choose trusted operator context.
No raw payout destination data in DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft/evidence survives refresh and restart and remains assignment-scoped.
Cross-partner/store access fails without ownership leakage.
Duplicate retries replay only the original result and payload drift is rejected.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused implementation without restoring local draft truth or weakening scope.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused onboarding-durability commit after targeted checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close operator review, WLT payout-reference boundary, partner readback and client publication gates for the field-created partner/store.
tasks.currentProblem: A submitted field draft is not closure until independent review, ownership-safe store linking, payout prerequisite and downstream readers converge.
tasks.requiredChange: Verify/correct review transitions, immutable audit, WLT reference handoff and publication eligibility/read models.
tasks.targetState: Partner and control panel read committed readiness; client sees the store only after every applicable publication gate.
tasks.action: Trace Product Truth operation IDs and current handlers/read models; add cross-surface negative tests for premature publication and forbidden ownership changes.
mustNotChange: No field self-approval or direct publication.
No generic store relink can reassign an owned store.
acceptanceCriteria: Operator review and partner readback show the same committed state.
Client cannot discover hidden/unready store and can discover it after all gates pass.
DSH stores/returns only allowed WLT payout references or masked values.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix state/audit inconsistencies; never bypass publication gates.
